Production logs JSON with machine-readable fields; local may be human-readable. Track latency, traffic, errors, and saturation at boundaries. Thread unique IDs through logs/spans. Keep metric label values bounded. Unbounded labels (like user IDs) explode storage costs.

Configure `structlog` with `structlog.contextvars.merge_contextvars`, `structlog.processors.add_log_level`, `structlog.processors.TimeStamper(fmt="iso")`, `structlog.processors.StackInfoRenderer()`, `structlog.processors.format_exc_info`, and `structlog.processors.JSONRenderer()`. Use `logger = structlog.get_logger()` and fields `correlation_id`, `method`, `path`, `user_id`, `duration_ms`, `error_type`, `error_message`. Every log entry should include standard fields for filtering and correlation. DEBUG diagnostics; INFO operations; WARNING recoverable anomalies; ERROR failures. Never log expected behavior at `
